asks: Did the first one of me already ask you this?
description: A person, and then the same person again a moment later, doing what the first one already did. Both of them are here. Neither is a copy, and the gap between them isn't closing.
emotes: {it} raises a hand, and raises it again shortly afterwards.
{it} catches up with itself and immediately falls behind again.
looks: The lag is about a second and never varies by so much as a blink.
Their mouth finishes a word some time after you have heard it.
When they stand still the two of them agree, and it's nearly restful.
name: somebody running slightly behind themselves
says: You're hearing the front of me.
I get there. It's only a matter of when.
